svg.aria-label: Circuit breaker states: closed lets calls through and counts failures; when failures pass a threshold it opens and fails fast without calling the dependency; after a cool-down it goes half-open and lets a few trial calls through, closing on success or opening again on failure.
svg.title: Circuit breaker states: closed lets calls through and counts failures; when failures pass a threshold it opens and fails fast without calling the dependency; after a cool-down it goes half-open and lets a few trial calls through, closing on success or opening again on failure.
svg.text: let a few trial calls through
While open, serve a fallback: cached data, a default, or a clear error. The dependency gets room to recover.
